name: image_routing_resolve_inference_base_url
notes: Agreed sub-contract: inputs where at most ONE providers entry matches. LIVE iterates candidate_names as a Python set (hash order, nondeterministic across runs) while the C port walks an ordered candidate list — multi-match inputs would be order-dependent and are excluded rather than faked. The runtime-override rung is traced as a single FALSE branch (fresh process carries no live runtime context on both sides).
